item.title: Mercor says it was hit by cyberattack tied to compromise of open-source LiteLLM project
item.description: The AI recruiting startup confirmed a security incident after an extortion hacking crew took credit for stealing data from the company's systems.

item.title: Anthropic is having a month
item.description: A human really borks things at Anthropic for the second time this week.

item.title: Salesforce announces an AI-heavy makeover for Slack, with 30 new features
item.description: Slack just got a whole lot more useful.

item.title: OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise
item.description: OpenAI's latest funding round, led by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, values the AI lab at $852 billion as it nears an IPO.

item.title: Yupp shuts down after raising $33M from a16z crypto’s Chris Dixon
item.description: Less than a year after launching, with checks from some of the biggest names in Silicon Valley, crowdsourced AI model feedback startup Yupp is closing its business, the company said Tuesday.

item.title: Alexa+ gets new food ordering experiences with Uber Eats and Grubhub
item.description: You can now order from Uber Eats and Grubhub using Alexa+, an experience Amazon says will be similar to chatting with a waiter at a restaurant or placing an order at a drive-thru.

item.title: Nomadic raises $8.4 million to wrangle the data pouring off autonomous vehicles
item.description: The company turns footage from robots into structured, searchable datasets with a deep learning model.

item.title: Exclusive: Runway launches $10M fund, Builders program to support early-stage AI startups
item.description: Runway is launching a $10 million fund and startup program to back companies building with its AI video models, as it pushes toward interactive, real-time “video intelligence” applications.

item.title: With its new app store, Ring bets on AI to go beyond home security
item.description: Ring's app store will allow the company to target broader use cases beyond security, like elder care or business needs.

item.title: 15% of Americans say they’d be willing to work for an AI boss, according to new poll
item.description: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 15% of Americans say they'd be willing to have a job where their direct supervisor was an AI program that assigned tasks and set schedules.

item.title: Popular AI gateway startup LiteLLM ditches controversial startup Delve
item.description: LiteLLM had obtained two security compliance certifications via Delve and fell victim to some horrific credential-stealing malware last week.

item.title: As more Americans adopt AI tools, fewer say they can trust the results
item.description: AI adoption is rising in the U.S., but trust remains low, with most Americans concerned about transparency, regulation, and the technology’s broader societal impact, according to a new Quinnipiac poll.

item.title: Mantis Biotech is making ‘digital twins’ of humans to help solve medicine’s data availability problem
item.description: Mantis takes disparate sources of data to make synthetic datasets that can be used to build so-called "digital twins" of the human body, representing anatomy, physiology and behavior.

item.title: ScaleOps raises $130M to improve computing efficiency amid AI demand
item.description: ScaleOps just raised $130M to tackle GPU shortages and soaring AI cloud costs by automating infrastructure in real time.

item.title: AI chip startup Rebellions raises $400 million at $2.3B valuation in pre-IPO round
item.description: The startup, which is planning to go public later this year, designs chips specifically for AI inference, another challenger to Nvidia's dominance.

item.title: Mistral AI raises $830M in debt to set up a data center near Paris
item.description: Mistral aims to start operating the data center by the second quarter of 2026.

item.title: Qodo raises $70M for code verification as AI coding scales
item.description: As AI floods software development with code, Qodo is betting the real challenge is making sure it actually works.

item.title: Starcloud raises $170 million Series A to build data centers in space
item.description: Starcloud becomes the fastest Y Combinator startup to reach unicorn status, just 17 months after demo day.

item.title: Why OpenAI really shut down Sora
item.description: OpenAI's decision last week to shut down Sora, its AI video-generation tool, just six months after releasing it to the public, raised immediate suspicions. The app had invited users to upload their own faces — so was this some kind of elaborate data grab?

item.title: Sora’s shutdown could be a reality check moment for AI video
item.description: Is this just normal corporate strategy, or are we about to see a broader pullback on AI-generated video?
